live_web_research.page_text: Workplace compliance and safety reporting | FaceUp Workplace compliance Catch risks early, on a platform you run Collect hazard and misconduct reports anonymously across your sites, handle each one as a case, and investigate when needed. You set up the forms, routing, and access, and adjust them as operations change. Book a demo RUN BY COMPLIANCE TEAMS WORLDWIDE Stay ahead of risk at every site Frontline workers, office teams, and contractors get a simple way to raise concerns, and each one reaches the person who can fix it. Surface hazards sooner Workers flag unsafe practices and near-misses from their phone, so safety leads can act before anyone's hurt. Route misconduct automatically Reports of theft, fraud, or labor violations go straight to the person you've assigned to that category or site. Protect every reporter Reporters choose whether to share their name, and every action that follows is logged, making retaliation harder to hide. Book a demo From report to documented fix, on one record Every report, online or by phone, becomes a case, and any case can open an investigation when it needs one. Anonymous Reporting Workers report on the web, in the app, by QR code, or by hotline (add-on), in the languages you publish, and can follow up anonymously. See how reporting works Case Management Every case moves through the stages you define, so someone is always accountable for the next step. Investigations Interviews, evidence, and findings are kept together in one place, so every outcome has a clear, documented basis. See how investigations run 4.8 /5 4.8 /5 4.9 /5 5 /5 Tailor reporting to each site No development project needed. Each site gets a form that reflects its own risks and procedures. Ask the questions your safety and compliance leads need Use categories such as hazards, near-misses, fraud, and policy breaches Route each report by site, region, or legal entity Add your logo, code of conduct, and safety guidelines to the form Make reporting easy in any workplace Whether people sit at a desk or work on site, the form is quick to fill in, works in their language, and lets them stay anonymous. Choose what the report is about from a short list Attach photos or documents as evidence Record a voice message instead of typing Record a voice message instead of typing Select the site or office where it happened Why compliance teams choose FaceUp Reports and cases stay protected from first message to final outcome. The platform fits every site and system you run, and a small team manages it without IT. Trusted anonymous reporting FaceUp never logs IP addresses or device data, so reporters can answer follow-up questions without revealing who they are. Audit-ready case management Every action, message, and decision is time-stamped in a tamper-proof activity log, ready for any audit or legal review. Confidential case handling Control who can open each case by category, department, region, or entity, so it stays away from the person it concerns. Oversight across entities Adapt each location to local laws where needed, while keeping oversight across your sites, regions, and legal entities. Works with your HR stack Sync employees from BambooHR or Rippling, get Slack or Teams alerts, and connect more via Zapier or Make. Change it yourself, any time Update forms, categories, routing, languages, and access rules, with changes live as soon as you save. Book a Demo Seamless integrations with 8,000+ apps Explore integrations Built for the safety and equality laws you answer to FaceUp supports the reporting, follow-up, and record-keeping parts of US and international workplace laws and standards like these. United States Title VII of the Civil Rights Act (1964) Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA) Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967 (ADEA) Pregnancy Discrimination Act of 1978 (PDA) Canada Canadian Human Rights Act Canada Labour Code – Part II (Occupational Health and Safety) Provincial Occupational Health and Safety Acts United Kingdom Equality Act 2010 Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 Australia Sex Discrimination Act 1984 Disability Discrimination Act 1992 Work Health and Safety Act 2011 European Union Employment Equality Framework Directive (2000/78/EC) Employment Equality Framework Directive (2000/78/EC) Gender Equality Recast Directive (2006/54/EC) Framework Directive on Safety and Health at Work (89/391/EEC) United Arab Emirates Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations Ministerial Resolution No. 44 of 2022 on Occupational Health and Safety and Labour Accommodation Saudi Arabia Saudi Labor Law (Royal Decree M/51), as amended in February 2025 Occupational Safety and Health Management Regulations (Ministerial Decision No. 161238/1439) Global ISO 37301:2021 (Compliance Management Systems) From the teams who run it themselves As we grew from hundreds to thousands, we needed a clean process that stayed organized and could be shared across multiple admins and remotely. World Relief Representative World Relief FaceUp is a must for companies with multiple locations. It makes gathering employee feedback efficient and anonymous, even across different countries. Thomas Rodny HR Director, Sportisimo I recommend FaceUp for any company dealing with whistleblowing. It is safe and easy to use. Plus, it helps combat bullying in schools. Rohia Hakim Compliance expert, CTP Invest I've admired FaceUp since its early days combating school bullying. Now, it helps companies protect their reputation, employees, and culture. Thomas Kafka Partner, Forensics & FinCrime, Deloitte FaceUp has been a game-changer. It’s intuitive, packed with useful features, and backed by a responsive support team. Vanessa Crawford HR Director, ADvTECH Group FaceUp made the setup process a breeze. The customer service was amazing, and the user experience is intuitive and easy to navigate. Tracey Banta HR Manager, Evention An intuitive and user-friendly platform. Its simplicity allows for a quick implementation, and I appreciate how flexible it is to meet our needs. Jaime Gómez Balderrama Director, Ética Integral To be compliant, we implemented FaceUp. It ticks the boxes for security, anonymity, and accessibility. Their team is always available to support us. Jiri Linek Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic Enterprise-grade security Independently certified. Encrypted and anonymous by design. FaceUp protects sensitive compliance data with independently verified security controls, so employees can trust the channel and speak up safely. Review our security ISO 27001 Certified GDPR Compliant Local Data Storage End-to-End Encryption Penetration Tested SOC 2 Servers FAQ Who is FaceUp for? Compliance, HR, and safety teams responsible for workplace risk, at one site or many. 3,600+ organizations in 70+ countries use FaceUp. See our Case Studies . How does FaceUp support workplace compliance? It gives employees, contractors, and anyone else you invite a secure way to report. Your team then works each report as a case: who handled it, what they found, and what changed. That record helps you show how every report was handled. What workplace issues can people report? Safety hazards and near-misses, harassment and discrimination, fraud and theft, conflicts of interest, labor law breaches, and other policy violations. You set the categories yourself. Can workers without a computer report? Yes. They can use the mobile app or a QR code posted on site, or call a hotline, available as an add-on. Calls and online reports arrive as cases side by side. Can each site handle its own cases? Yes. Route cases by category, department, region, or entity, and decide who can open each one. You can oversee all your sites while local teams work their own reports. Which regulations does FaceUp help with? Workplace safety, equality, and reporting laws across the US, Canada, the UK, the EU, Australia, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, plus ISO 37301. See the Compliance Hub for each law. How do we set FaceUp up? Your team sets up categories, sites, languages, and access in the admin settings. Our customer success team can help if you want it. Can FaceUp integrate with other tools? Yes. Case alerts go to Slack or Microsoft Teams, employee data syncs from HR systems such as BambooHR or Rippling, and Zapier and Make connect further apps. See the Integrations Hub . Can FaceUp do more than workplace compliance? Yes. The same ethics and compliance platform runs whistleblowing, employee relations, and disclosures such as conflicts of interest and gifts, so you can add workflows without changing systems. article.body:
Tri-service accommodation regulations updated

The Ministry of Defence has published updated Tri-service accommodation regulations (TSARs) (JSP 464). The new guidance covers the provision of Service family accommodation (SFA), single living accommodation (SLA) and their substitute equivalents. The regulations take effect immediately.

The updated TSARs include changes to UK Accommodation Policy, UK Accommodation Procedures, UK Charging and Assessment Guide, UK and Overseas Accommodation Pilots, and Overseas Accommodation Policy. The regulations also introduce the Future Accommodation Model (FAM) pilot.

The new regulations aim to improve the quality and efficiency of accommodation provision for service personnel and their families. The regulations also address the need for adaptability to accommodate changing accommodation requirements and the increasing use of substitute equivalents.

The updated TSARs are available on the GOV.UK website.
